n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (The gate core dies with a sound like ice breaking. The monsters do not.)

n2.speaker: momo
n2.text: Behind us—there are more behind us!

n3.speaker: faelen
n3.text: Tight formation. Back to the core. Do not give them a seam.

n4.speaker: player
n4.text: (A hooked limb punches through Faelen's guard and into her side. She traps it there, using her own body to hold the creature still.)

n6.speaker: player
n6.text: (Your blade finds the exposed throat. Momo's light takes the next beast. Silence arrives all at once.)

n7.speaker: player
n7.text: "Sit down. Let me see the wound."

n11.speaker: player
n11.text: (Faelen turns away and begins stitching her own side with hands that are almost steady.)

n12.speaker: player
n12.text: "You knew that hit would land. You took it anyway."

choices.text: "Next time I call a retreat, you retreat with us. That's an order."
"I trust your call. Trust us to carry part of the cost."

order2.speaker: player
order2.text: "Then call it the price of fighting on my team. Nobody gets left behind—even on purpose."

order3.speaker: faelen
order3.text: Your formation discipline is appalling. Your rule is not.

trust1.speaker: faelen
trust1.text: Trust is what put me in front of the blow.

trust2.speaker: player
trust2.text: "No. Fear did. You were afraid we'd fail if you didn't pay for all of us."

trust3.speaker: faelen
trust3.text: ...Next time, I will leave you something to carry.

converge.speaker: player
converge.text: (She allows you to finish the last stitch. Her jaw stays clenched, but she does not take the needle back.)

n14.speaker: faelen
n14.text: The technique I used—the challenge, the anchored guard. I can teach you how to fight behind it.
